subject: downloadHandler does not work well with Shiny.onInputChange()

messages.author: 879cc09926aa664c
messages.subject: downloadHandler does not work well with Shiny.onInputChange()
parts:
Hello team,

I am building a web tool using Shiny Server.R and try to add a functionality to download csv file. Because the tool is currently built with html and javascript instead of ui.R, I am running the such function to pass in user input dynamically to server to generate the content of csv file.

in .html

<a id="downloadData" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm shiny-download-link shiny-bound-output" style="display:inline" target="_blank" href="session/54a5a35f2aee8049087730a3d6e46c33/download/downloadData?w="><i class="fa fa-floppy-o" aria-hidden="true"></i> Download</a>

in .js file 

Shiny.onInputChange("mydata", JSON.stringify(itemList));

in server.R

output$downloadData = downloadHandler(
      
      filename = paste("filename",format(Sys.Date(),"%Y%m%d"),"csv",sep="."),
      content = function(file){
        print(input$mydata)
        write.csv(input$mydata,file,row.names=FALSE)
      }
)

By click Download button, it does generate a csv file but the content (input$mydata) is always based on the previous input.

for example, when first load the page and set itemList to 1 and click the Download button, it doesn't generate any file but says error with NULL on a separate page. Then if i update itemList to 2 and click the Download button again, server.R generates a csv file but when i open the file, it contains 1 instead of 2.

Has anyone seen such issue while using downloadHandler with onInputChange()?

Please let me know.

Thanks you!

messages.subject: Re: downloadHandler does not work well with Shiny.onInputChange()
